criteria.requirement: Add ArgumentParser.discover_config_files() for declared default_config_files only. Return ordered fresh records matching existing glob expansion and duplicate source order: path records contain kind,index,path,exists; unmatched declarations produce exists=false; provider records contain only kind="provider",index,executed=false. Support PathLike and expanduser with path-before-callable precedence. Do not open files, invoke providers, inspect their repr, run argument actions or mutate last parse/source state. Discovery is a filesystem snapshot, not a promise of later readability; real parsing behavior stays unchanged.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
